surviving_claim: With the v0.24 dual-copy direct-address layout, deleting eager full-generation extension does not asymptotically bound stale file-length residue. A first lazy write materializes one logical page but can extend file length by 4096(C-1) bytes for the last bucket or 4096(C+1) for the stash, both Theta(C).
non_claims: file-length range is not filesystem allocated-block usage
one logical page materialized is not one physical storage-device write
sparse-file allocation, filesystem journaling, latency, and hardware power-loss behavior are not measured
